text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
MAURITIUS, June 3 - Port Louis - ten vessels alongside (3 containers, 7 general cargo). 1 vessel at buoys berth. no idle vessels. 9 vessels in fishing port. port labour working to maximum capacity.

PAKISTAN, June 2 - Karachi - Nine vessels due. Delays expected 1 day for general cargo/containers, 3-4 days for tankers. 2 rice vessels loading at berth. 3 container vessels loading/discharging at berth. 3 vessels discharging general cargo and mogas at berth. 5 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (vegetable oil, fuel oil, gas oil, sulphur). 1 vessel awaiting orders. Berths 23 and 24 closed to shipping due to commencement of reconstruction work at the APL container terminal. Port Qasim - three vessels discharging at berth (sugar, cars, jute). 1 vessel loading crude oil at berth. 3 vessels waiting at anchorage to load (fuel oil, wheat, palm oil).

PHILIPPINES, June 2 - Manila - Fifteen vessels discharging at berth. 14 vessels discharging at anchorage. 15 vessels waiting at outside anchorage to discharge. 2 other vessels. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft less than 8 metres and LOA less than 130 metres 1-2 days. Draft more than 9 metres and LOA more than 140 metres 2-3 days.
